title: Accounts Administrator
company: Capital Outsourcing Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Administrator

Join a growing team and play a key role in keeping the finances running smoothly.

Salary: £30,000 per annum

Full-time Permanent Monday-Friday, 40 hrs

We're looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Accounts Administrator to join a busy finance team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, takes pride in getting things right and thrives in a role where accuracy, organisation and teamwork really matter.

You'll play an important part in supporting the day-to-day finance function, working across accounts payable, customer accounts, payments, reconciliations and general financial administration.

What you'll be doing

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices and credit notes
- Reviewing supplier statements and ensuring invoices are received and processed accurately
- Supporting the management and collection of outstanding customer balances
- Setting up new customer and supplier accounts
- Processing employee expenses
- Preparing and making supplier payments
- Handling incoming finance-related queries by phone and email
- Processing payments securely over the phone
- Posting bank transactions using accounting software
- Managing the finance team inbox and ensuring queries are dealt with promptly
- Supporting the release of orders where payment requirements have been met
- Providing general finance administration and support to the wider team
- Taking on additional duties and projects as required

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is:
- Experienced in a Financial Administrator, Accounts Assistant or similar role
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable working with financial information and deadlines
- Confident using accounting systems and Microsoft Office
- Enjoys working in a fast paced and busy environment
- Reliable, proactive and able to manage competing priorities
- A positive team player who is happy to get stuck in

Previous experience using SAP or similar business/accounting systems would be advantageous, but isn't essential.

Why join us?

This is more than a processing role. You'll become an important part of a collaborative finance team and have the opportunity to develop your skills across a broad range of financial activities.

We offer:
- £30, 000 annual salary
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Company pension
- On-site parking
- A supportive team environment
- Opportunities to develop your finance experience

The role

Job title: Accounts Administrator

Salary: £30,000 per annum

Contract: Full-time, Permanent

Hours: Monday-Friday, 40 hrs

Working arrangement: Office-based

COG LTD are acting as an employment agency.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Our client is a well established and growing business looking to strengthen its finance team with the addition of a Finance Assistant.

This role will support the Finance Manager across a range of transactional finance and month end activities whilst working within a collaborative and supportive finance team based in Harrogate.

We feel this role would suit an engaging individual at the early stages of their finance career who is looking to develop their skills within a successful and expanding organisation.

Main duties of the role:
- Bank reconciliations
- Ledger reconciliations across multiple entities and accounts
- Accounts payable including invoice processing, statement reconciliations and payment runs
- Preparing payroll schedules
- Processing intercompany transactions
- Supplier statement reviews
- Ensuring the accuracy of financial transactions, charges and account balances
- Assisting with month-end processes including accruals, prepayments and reporting
- Producing reports for internal review and analysis

Salary: £28,000 - £30,000 plus benefits

IPS Finance has over 40 years' experience in the Yorkshire accountancy recruitment market. We have built our business on long-term relationships with both individuals and clients across all sectors, bringing real benefits to all concerned. Please visit our website to view the latest accountancy, finance and practice opportunities.

title: Interim Finance Assistant
description:
Delighted to be partnering with a well established business in North Yorkshire to assist to bring a Finance Assistant on a temp basis (likely to go permanent)

Key Responsibilities
- Record and reconcile income, support daily bank recs, and resolve banking queries.
- Raise invoices, reconcile payments, and resolve discrepancies.
- Process investment transactions and assist with monthly reconciliations.
- Support supplier payments, manage petty cash, monitor POs, investigate variances, and set up new suppliers.
- Assist with PO accruals and lead stock reconciliation.
- Act as first point of contact, set up users, and deliver training.
- Process employee expenses in line with policy.
- Support year-end audit, provide ledger cover, and assist the Finance Manager during leave periods.

title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: An exciting opportunity has become available for a full time Administrative Assistant / Receptionist at Ripon Spa Surgery, a busy friendly semi-rural Practice. Teamwork is essential to this role as you will be working within our already well-established administration team. The ideal candidate should be a compassionate, calm and well-motivated individual who has a lovely telephone manner, be able to work under pressure with good organisational and computer skills. We are seeking enthusiastic and dynamic applicants. The role is varied and would suit an individual who has previous GP Practice experience, although not essential. You will need to be organised and able to prioritise your own workload. Full training will be provided to the successful candidate. Within this position you will be required to maintain strict confidentiality and will be expected to always deal with patients and relatives with courtesy and discretion. Provide cover for the telephone results line, communicating test results to patients in line with practice protocols. Workflow within the clinical system Supporting recall systems Handling patient queries where appropriate Provide administrative support to cover for colleagues; scan, file, and accurately attach incoming documents to patient records, medical reports, scanning of documents, opening post. Work with colleagues to support with typing of referral letters ( training will be provided). Coding of letters on to patient records from hospitals, A&E attendances etc ( training will be provided). Managing and actioning day-to-day tasks, including emails. Support general practice administrative tasks as required. Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information. Answering incoming calls, transferring calls, responding to patients. Organising, implementing and liaising with patients for Patient Participation Group Meetings. Support all staff with queries and general administrative tasks. To have knowledge of all practice procedures and to work in accordance to written protocols To provide administrative support and cover duties for other members of staff if required Welcoming patients upon arrival at the front desk of the surgery Making appointments for patients via telephone or face to face Handling queries from patients and diverting them to the right department Handing completed repeat prescriptions to patients and checking names and address Dealing with doctors visit requests and printing the relevant information for the doctor Maintaining the reception area to a professional standard
